stories.title: US stock futures steady after tech-led rebound, CPI data in focus
stories.summary: US stock futures held steady after a rebound led by technology shares. Investors are now focused on an upcoming CPI inflation report. The data could shape the Federal Reserve's next move on interest rates.
stories.whyItMatters: Inflation data drives Fed rate expectations, which move both stocks and bonds.
whatToWatch: Fed commentary that follows the data
questions: How large was the tech-led rebound?
What will the CPI report show?

stories.title: Equinix chief legal officer sells $200,807 in company stock
stories.summary: Equinix's chief legal officer sold $200,807 in company stock, per a new regulatory filing. The filing does not state a reason for the sale. Insider sales like this are routine disclosures and do not by themselves signal a view on the stock.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider sale filings give investors a small window into how company executives treat their own stock.
whatToWatch: Further insider filings from Equinix executives
questions: Was this a scheduled sale or a discretionary one?

stories.title: National Health Investors earnings beat estimates, revenue falls short
stories.summary: National Health Investors reported quarterly earnings that beat analyst estimates by $10.28. Revenue, however, came in below estimates. The report shows profit outperforming expectations while sales lagged.
stories.whyItMatters: An earnings beat paired with a revenue miss signals cost control offsetting softer demand, a pattern investors track across sectors.
whatToWatch: Management's comments on revenue trends in the earnings call
